# Task P8-08a: The docs site — scaffold and the setup path (install, Soulseek, Plex, qBittorrent, SABnzbd, indexers)

**Phase:** 8 · **Depends on:** none · **Delegate:** sonnet subagent (the orchestrator reviews every page against the code, and writes the Pages workflow) · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
Phase 8's gate: "the docs cover setup with slskd, Plex and qBittorrent end to end" — a new user installs Wondarr from the docs alone and gets a song from each source into a Plex library. This task creates the user documentation site with Starlight (Astro) in `website/` (DECISIONS build session 10 #4) and writes the pages on that path. P8-08b adds the remaining feature pages. Accuracy is everything: every setting name, environment variable, path, port, default and UI label must be the one the code uses today — read the code and the architecture docs, never guess, and leave out anything you cannot confirm.

## Deliverables
- `website/` — a Starlight site: `package.json` (scripts `dev`, `build`, `preview`; `astro` and `@astrojs/starlight` at their current stable versions, exact versions, plus `starlight-links-validator` so broken internal links fail the build), `package-lock.json`, `astro.config.mjs` (`site: 'https://wulfftech.github.io'`, `base: '/wondarr'`, title "Wondarr", the GitHub social link `https://github.com/wulfftech/wondarr`, an `editLink` to `https://github.com/wulfftech/wondarr/edit/main/website/`, a sidebar in the order below), `tsconfig.json` as Starlight's template has it, `src/content.config.ts`, `src/content/docs/…`, `public/favicon.svg` (copy `frontend/public/favicon.svg` if it exists, else Starlight's default), `.gitignore` (`node_modules`, `dist`, `.astro`), and `README.md` (how to run it locally).
- Pages (Markdown/MDX under `src/content/docs/`), in this sidebar order:
  1. `index.mdx` — what Wondarr is (one paragraph from `README.md`/`docs/product/PRODUCT.md`: the *arr for single songs; Soulseek → YouTube Music → torrents/usenet; verified imports; Plexamp-friendly layouts), a "Get started" card linking the install page, and the licence (GPL-3.0).
  2. `getting-started/install.md` — Docker run and Docker Compose (from `docker/docker-compose.yml`, with the published image `ghcr.io/wulfftech/wondarr:latest` for releases and `:develop` for the main branch), the volumes `/config` and `/data` and why one `/data` mount (hard links for torrents, `DEPLOYMENT.md`), the ports 1077 (web UI and API) and 50300 (Soulseek listen port — forward it on the router for better Soulseek results), `PUID`/`PGID`/`UMASK`/`TZ`, a URL base behind a reverse proxy (the config key and env override — check `docs/architecture/CONFIG_EXAMPLES.md` and the server options class), architectures (linux/amd64, linux/arm64), where the API key is (`/config/config.yml`, Settings → General if the UI shows it — check `frontend/src/pages/settings/`), and upgrading (pull the new image; the database migrates on start; a backup is taken first if the code does that — check; otherwise recommend System → Backup first).
  3. `getting-started/unraid.md` — a placeholder page with the Community Applications steps the orchestrator will fill (heading + one line: "Coming with the Unraid template").
  4. `getting-started/first-run.md` — sign-in/authentication options (Forms login, "disabled for local addresses", the API key header `X-Api-Key`), the first library (Settings → Library: root folder, layout incl. the Plexamp preset, naming template), quality profiles (the defaults "Standard 320" and "Lossless"), and adding the first songs (search, paste a list).
  5. `sources/soulseek.md` — the bundled slskd: Settings → Soulseek (username/password, listen port, shared folders and "Share my library", slots/limits, the read-only fields when set by env), the env vars `APP__SOULSEEK__USERNAME`/`APP__SOULSEEK__PASSWORD` (confirm in code), the search budget Wondarr enforces (≤ 30 searches / 4 min, ≤ 2 outstanding) and why, one login per account (a desktop client with the same account kicks it), health messages; **external slskd** mode (`soulseek.mode: external`, `soulseek.external.url/api_key`, and what stays read-only) — from `docs/DECISIONS.md` build session 6 #6 and the Soulseek options classes.
  6. `sources/plex.md` — Settings → Plex: sign in through plex.tv (PIN), pick the server ("Connect"), map each library to a Plex music section and its path as Plex sees it (the path mapping), partial scans after imports, "Prefer local metadata" on the Plex section (why: pseudo-albums), the Plexamp layout, playlists from import lists. Labels from `frontend/src/pages/settings/` (Plex page).
  7. `sources/qbittorrent.md` — Settings → Download clients → qBittorrent (host, port, username/password, category, remote path mappings), the shared `/data` layout for hard links (`import.container_staging_path`, default `/data/downloads/containers`), what Wondarr does (adds the torrent stopped with only the wanted files selected, hard-links the finished file, keeps seeding, never deletes torrent data), qBittorrent 4.x and 5.x both work, the Test button. From `DECISIONS.md` build sessions 8–9 and `src/Wondarr.Sources.Torznab/` (qBittorrent client type fields).
  8. `sources/indexers.md` — Settings → Indexers: Torznab, Newznab, Prowlarr (one row over Prowlarr's search) and Gazelle trackers with an API key; categories; how a song is searched on an indexer (the releases it appears on, then the file inside the release); `release/push` for autobrr (the endpoint, Lidarr-compatible).
  9. `sources/sabnzbd.md` — Settings → Download clients → SABnzbd (host, API key, category, the complete folder through remote path mappings), trimming of clean posts, unpacking and the job deleted after import.
  10. `sources/youtube.md` — a short page: the source is off by default, the one-time disclaimer, Art Tracks first, files ranked as `OPUS-160` and converted to AAC 256 by default, cookies / PO token settings if the settings page has them (check), and that it runs only when Soulseek yields nothing acceptable.
  11. `guides/end-to-end.md` — the gate walkthrough in one page: install with compose (Wondarr + qBittorrent on one `/data`), sign in to Soulseek, connect Plex and map the library, add qBittorrent and one indexer (or `release/push`), add three songs, watch Activity → Queue, see them in Plex. Link the detailed pages instead of repeating them.
- Do not document features that do not exist. When unsure whether a UI label is exact, read the page's `.tsx`.

## Constraints
- Node: the version the repository already uses (`frontend/package.json` `engines` / `.nvmrc` if present; Node 24 on this machine).
- Plain, direct prose in British spelling as the rest of the repository uses ("licence", "colour"); short pages; code blocks for every command and config snippet; no marketing language.
- No secrets or real hostnames in examples (use `wondarr.example`, `192.168.1.10`, `your-api-key`).

2. Every page in the list exists and is in the sidebar.
3. A list in the done-report of every setting name, env var, path and default you documented, each with the source file you confirmed it in.
